posts.title: Disable GitHub's custom font
posts.description: Here’s a fontconfig setup for disabling “Mona Sans VF”, GitHub’s custom font. It also has a tweak for re-enabling color emojis once you do that: Mona Sans VF sans-serif Noto Color Emoji charset 0x0000 0x203c sans-serif Noto Color Emoji serif Noto Color Emoji monospace Noto Color Emoji
